question: At what time are the lotus feet of Dhūmāvatī especially worshipped?
premises: Dhūmāvatī has lotus feet worthy of worship.
Her lotus feet are to be worshipped at night.
inference: Dhūmāvatī is served as one whose lotus feet are worshipped at night.
plain_english: I serve Dhūmāvatī, whose lotus feet are to be worshipped at night.
